skill.name: google-drive-automation
skill.description: Guides Google Workspace users through command-line search, download, upload, organization, and OAuth workflows for Google Drive.
skill.summary: Run documented Google Drive file and folder workflows from an AI coding assistant.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 22 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, and official Google Drive example URLs. The skill still has material risks because referenced scripts are absent and destructive Drive commands lack explicit confirmation controls.

remediation.issue: The documented authentication and Drive scripts are not included in the package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed scripts, resolve them from the skill directory, and document pinned dependencies before instructing agents to execute them.

remediation.issue: Move, rename, and trash operations can modify remote data without an explicit confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Require a preview and user confirmation before every destructive or organizational write operation.

content.value_statement: Manual Google Drive file management is slow and difficult to repeat. This skill documents command-line workflows for searching, transferring, and organizing Workspace files.
actual_capabilities: Documents OAuth login, status, and logout commands for Google Workspace accounts.
Provides search examples for text, titles, shared files, URLs, folder identifiers, and native Drive queries.
Documents file listing and paginated result workflows.
Provides commands for uploading, downloading, copying, moving, renaming, and trashing files.
Documents folder discovery and nested folder creation.
limitations: The package does not include the referenced authentication or Drive scripts.
Personal Gmail accounts are not supported.
Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides require export or dedicated tools for downloads.
Full read and write access can expose or modify all data allowed by the granted OAuth scope.

use_cases.title: Find Project Files
use_cases.description: Search Drive by phrase, title, folder, or shared status and return relevant identifiers.

use_cases.title: Publish Team Deliverables
use_cases.description: Upload reports to a selected Workspace folder with a clear destination and filename.

use_cases.title: Organize Shared Drives
use_cases.description: Preview folder changes, then move, copy, or rename approved files.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Google Drive for [phrase] and show the file names, identifiers, types, and modified dates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search using a clear phrase

prompt_templates.title: List a Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to [count] files in folder [folder ID], including names and identifiers, without changing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Upload a Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [local path] to folder [folder ID] as [Drive name], after confirming the source and destination.

prompt_templates.title: Reorganize Approved Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Find files matching [query], propose moves into [folder ID], and execute only the changes I explicitly approve.

output_examples.input: Find files with quarterly report in the name.
output: Q1 Quarterly Report, PDF, modified March 29.
Q2 Quarterly Report, document, modified June 30.
Quarterly Report Template, document, modified January 5.

output_examples.input: List the contents of the Finance folder.
output: The first page includes Budgets, Invoices, Forecasts, and Audit Reports.
A continuation token is available for the next page.

output_examples.input: Move the approved report into the Archive folder.
output_examples.output: Ready to move Q4 Report.pdf into Archive. Confirm the file and destination before the Drive change is applied.

best_practices: Confirm OAuth scopes and the active Workspace account before accessing Drive data.
Use file and folder identifiers when names are duplicated.
Preview and confirm every move, rename, upload, copy, or trash operation.
anti_patterns: Do not execute referenced scripts until their source and installation path are verified.
Do not use broad native queries when a precise title or folder search is sufficient.
Do not trash or reorganize files from incomplete identifiers or ambiguous names.

faq.question: Does this skill support personal Gmail accounts?
faq.answer: No. The documentation states that a Google Workspace account is required.

faq.question: Does the skill include an MCP server?
faq.answer: No. It describes standalone command-line scripts and does not require an MCP server.

faq.question: Are the required scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, so the referenced scripts need a trusted source.

faq.question: Can it download Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides?
faq.answer: Not directly. Those files require export support or dedicated tools.

faq.question: Where are OAuth tokens stored?
faq.answer: The documentation says tokens use the operating system keyring.

faq.question: Should write operations run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review the target identifiers and require explicit approval before each remote change.
